visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard and mustache, wearing sunglasses on his head and a black sleeveless tank top, stands on a sandy beach. He speaks animatedly with wide eyes and a beaming smile. Behind him is the bright blue ocean under a clear sky, with small boats visible on the horizon. (2) The scene shifts to an underwater environment. A diver in full scuba gear (mask, wetsuit, tank) is seen writing on a white waterproof board among vibrant coral reefs. Bubbles rise steadily from the regulator. A large, heart-shaped golden sculpture sits on the seabed, followed by a close-up of a seahorse-shaped structure that says 'POST.' (3) A sea turtle swims gracefully over corals in the foreground while a diver points at it in the background. Two divers are seen underwater, one giving a 'three-finger' hand signal to the other, practicing communication in the blue water. (4) Transition to land-based training. A man with glasses and a tattoo on his forearm demonstrates a technique by pressing his nose. Several large grey air tanks with pink collars are lined up near a truck. A woman in a pink-rimmed diving mask and regulator practices breathing and ear-clearing techniques under the guidance of an instructor in a green cap. (5) A woman in a dark green bikini stands on a coastal road, smiling broadly and brushing her hair back. The video concludes with the first man, now wearing a grey tank top and green hat, standing near a white truck in a harbor area, speaking directly to the camera with a playful expression.
